name: can-loopback-routing
description: Physical can0/can1 wired onto one shared bus -- a DUT-free HIL stand-in for verifying the gateway's own send-to-wire-to-receive frame path (not a PduRouter routing feature -- physical CAN buses are broadcast, so anything sent on either interface's transceiver is seen by both). Used by manifest_can_loopback.json's routing test: payload integrity, per-frame latency, and no drops/duplicates between can0 (send) and can1 (observe).
